killable.label: Turn off links-api on workers.dev
killable.description: Stops requests through the workers.dev URL and preview URLs. Custom domains, cron triggers and queue consumers keep running.

killable.label: Block mail.example.com
killable.description: Cloudflare answers every request to mail.example.com with a 403 before it reaches a Worker, so blocked requests aren't billed. Takes 6-20 s to reach every data centre. WebSockets already open stay open.

killable.label: Stop mailbox's cron triggers
killable.description: Removes the cron schedules; undo puts the same schedules back. HTTP traffic keeps flowing.
